text: Wei, a property agent in Taiwan, lives with his grandmother until [she vanishes one day|trigger|someone goes missing]. A camera arrives at his office holding footage of her hiking with friends, and following the group is [a little girl in a red dress|threat|the restless dead]. Wei grows sweaty and strange, stares into an empty hospital nursery, and is found [eating bugs and worms without knowing it|images|vermin and creeping things], while his girlfriend Yi-Chun, a radio DJ, uncovers [the mountain legend of the Little Girl in Red|origin|old beliefs and legends].
